site.description: Union Square, San Francisco, CA (assumed point)

seismic_weight.facade_weight_basis: exterior wall surface area per story
seismic_weight.live_load_contribution_note: Set to zero because no live-load participation was provided; revise if applicable.
calculation_notes: Floor area x (self-weight + superimposed dead load) gives floor weight.
Facade perimeter x story height x facade weight gives facade weight per story.

accidental_torsion.torsional_amplification_note: Placeholder only; determine Ax if required by Section 12.8.4.3 based on torsional irregularity analysis.

output_contract.description: Write JSON to stdout mapping floor index to story force magnitude in kips.

limitations: Illustrative calculation inputs; not a sealed or project-specific design.
The selected system's ASCE 7-22 Table 12.2-1 height limit for SDC D is 160 ft, while this building is 960 ft. The specified system is therefore outside the listed height limit.
Only the stated floor dead loads and facade weight are included in seismic weight; live-load contribution is zero unless supplied.
No concentrated roof force is included; ASCE 7-22 Section 12.8.3 distributes Fx using Equations 12.8-12 and 12.8-13.
